envelope.name: id
envelope.description: Deduplication key: lower-case hex SHA-256 of the tenant, resource type, resource id, meter, component, billing dimensions, interval start, interval end, and heartbeat time. It leaves out the quantity and the external billing account id, so a resend carries the same id.

envelope.name: type
envelope.description: CloudEvents type. Always osac.resource.heartbeat.v1; the suffix is the schema version.

envelope.name: source
envelope.description: Producer of the event. Always osac-metering.

envelope.name: datacontenttype
envelope.description: Media type of the payload. Always application/json.

envelope.name: time
envelope.description: CloudEvents time. Equal to the interval start in data.usage.from.

envelope.name: osacresourceid
envelope.description: Resource id the usage belongs to. Equal to data.resource_id.

envelope.name: osacresourcetype
envelope.description: Resource type value the usage belongs to. Equal to data.resource_type.

envelope.name: osactenant
envelope.description: Tenant the usage belongs to. Equal to data.tenant_id.

data.name: resource_type
data.description: Resource type value the usage belongs to, for example cluster_order. The resources section lists every value.

data.name: resource_id
data.description: Id of the resource the usage belongs to.

data.name: meter
data.description: Meter name from the default rule revision, for example compute.

data.name: component
data.description: Billable line the meter feeds. It is the meter name unless the rule revision sets another.

data.name: billing_dimensions
data.description: Dimension name to value for the interval. Each event carries its meter's dimensions plus deployment, tenant, project, catalog, template, and meter_type.

data.name: usage
data.description: One measured interval. From is inclusive and to is exclusive.

fields.name: semantics
fields.description: Always interval: the quantity covers one interval and is never cumulative.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Measured quantity as fixed-point text with exactly six decimals. Negative for a correction.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Meter unit, for example second or gibibyte_second.

fields.name: precision
fields.description: Source clock precision. Always second; every timestamp is whole seconds.

data.name: heartbeat_time
data.description: Round time that produced the event. It is part of the deduplication key.

data.name: last_applied_offset
data.description: Position in the tenant's event topic the round had folded.

data.name: rules_revision
data.description: Rule revision that produced the event, for example 0001.

data.name: external_billing_account_id
data.description: Tenant's external billing account id, when the tenant has one. The provider supplies it; OSAC copies it as given. M360 keeps its own mapping. The event omits it otherwise.
